# Design tokens

A token is a CSS custom property. A theme's block (`.<id>`) sets most of them; `styles/tokens.css` sets the motion tokens. Values below are the default theme's (Berghain); `themes-resolved.md` has every theme's values. "Applied in" is sampled from component source: the three components that use the token most (not exhaustive).

Counts: 207 custom properties, 49 text styles and glass surfaces.

| Token | Default value | Meaning | Applied in (sampled) |

| `--background` | `oklch(0.000 0.000 0.00)` | Page surface. Everything else (card, popover) is derived from it. | avatar, gradient-background, kbd (+21) |
| `--foreground` | `oklch(0.988 0.001 286.38)` | Ink on the page; border, input, ring and muted-foreground are this colour at set opacities. | insight-cards, date-time-picker, dropdown-menu (+79) |
| `--card` | `var(--background)` | Card surface colour. No Figma variable: it comes from the theme's texture setting (Figma settings/texture) and colour mode. Solid: the background 20% toward white (light) or black (dark). Gradient: 15% toward. Glass: the background itself, because the blur layer is the surface. | `--motion-duration` | `0.8s` | Duration of the theme's Component Animations choice (0s for none). | thinking-state, selection-actions, task-rows (+14) |
| `--motion-spring-bounce` | `0` | Bounce of the Springy choice (0 for the others). | `useThemeSpring()` |
| `--motion-fast` | `var(--duration-fast)` | How long a hover takes: `--duration-fast`, or instant when motion is none. | date-time-picker, prompt-bar, map-carousel (+52) |
| `--motion-transition-ease` | `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.35, 1)` | Easing for plain CSS transitions: the theme curve, or the spring sampled as `linear()`. | selection-actions, sidebar, thinking-state (+48) |

## Typescale by step

Line-height comes from the theme: body steps read `--font-body-line-height` (default 1.6), heading steps `--font-primary-line-height` / `--font-secondary-line-height` (default 1.4). Sizes (px) per `scale` mode are in `themes.md`. The size ladder maps as: xs→xs, sm→sm, base→md, lg→lg, xl→lg, 2xl→h6, 3xl→h5, 4xl→h4, 5xl→h3, 6xl→h2, 7xl→h1.

## Motion tokens

Easing curves (`--ease-<group>-<strength>`):

| Token | cubic-bezier |
|---|---|
| `--ease-in-out-normal` | cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 0.2, 1) |
| `--ease-in-out-slight` | cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) |
| `--ease-in-out-strong` | cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.04, 1) |
| `--ease-in-out-back` | cubic-bezier(0.4, -0.6, 0.6, 1.6) |
| `--ease-in-normal` | cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 1, 0.8) |
| `--ease-in-strong` | cubic-bezier(0.95, 0, 1, 1) |
| `--ease-in-back` | cubic-bezier(0.4, -0.4, 1, 0.8) |
| `--ease-out-normal` | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.35, 1) |
| `--ease-out-strong` | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.02, 1) |
| `--ease-out-back` | cubic-bezier(0, 0.4, 0.4, 1.4) |
| `--ease-out-in-transition-out-in` | cubic-bezier(0, 0.7, 1, 0.3) |

Springs (bounce): subtle 0.5, normal 0.7005, expressive 0.75. Timing (s): instant 0, fast 0.2, faster 0.4, long 0.8, longer 1.2, longest 2.4. Hold: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.58, 1).

Component Animations choices:

| Choice | Easing | Duration | Spring bounce |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | — | 0s | — |
| ease | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.35, 1) | 0.8s | — |
| emphatic | cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 0.2, 1) | 0.4s | — |
| springy | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.35, 1) | 0.8s | 0.7005 |

Page-transition speeds: slow 1.2s, medium 0.8s, fast 0.4s.
